parameters.name: AssertKey
parameters.description:
The log subscription type. Valid values:

- **risk**: risk information.
- **event**: attack event information.
- **asset**: asset information.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The enabling status of API security log subscribe. Valid values:

- **true**: subscribe is enabled.

- **false**: subscribe is shutdown.
